trap.label: conjunções e vírgula
trap.wrong: I was tired, because I slept late.
trap.right: I was tired because I slept late.
trap.why: Em português escrevemos 'estava cansado, porque…' com vírgula; em inglês because não leva vírgula antes.

mcq.q: I like tea ___ I don't like coffee.

fix.wrong: I was late, because the bus was slow.
fix.right: I was late because the bus was slow.

fix.wrong: It's cold, but I wear a coat.
fix.right: It's cold, so I wear a coat.

fix.wrong: I like pizza and I don't like fish.
fix.right: I like pizza but I don't like fish.

rewrite.prompt: Una com because: “I'm tired. I worked late.”
rewrite.answer: I'm tired because I worked late.

rewrite.prompt: Una com but: “I like tea. I don't like milk.”
rewrite.answer: I like tea but I don't like milk.

rewrite.prompt: Una com so: “It rains. I stay home.”
rewrite.answer: It rains so I stay home.
